preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'val') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right'))
preconditions.description: The input root is either None or a valid tree node with 'val', 'left', and 'right' attributes.
The tree structure is finite and acyclic, forming a valid binary tree.

postconditions.description: The function returns a non-negative integer representing the count.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in all_nodes(root) if is_single_valued_subtree(node))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the total count of all subtrees rooted at any node in the tree where every node in that subtree has the same value.
